dossier.headline: HAL's Q2 profit rises but margins slip; shares fall
dossier.summary: HAL reported higher Q2 FY27 profit on November 12, but EBITDA grew more slowly than revenue and margins narrowed. The shares fell 2.3% by 1:40 PM, and the decline later deepened to about 4%.
why_it_matters: Profit growth did not stop the selling because margins narrowed
